title: High-resolution mapping of Sigma Factor DNA Binding Sequences using Artificial Promoters, RNA Aptamers and Deep Sequencing
authors: Essa Ahsan Khan; Christian Rückert-Reed; Gurvinder Singh Dahiya; Lisa Tietze; Maxime Fages-Lartaud; Tobias Busche; Jörn Kalinowski; Victoria Shingler; Rahmi Lale
one_liner_zh: 该文用人工启动子文库、RNA适配体和深度测序高通量绘制细菌σ54因子DNA结合序列，虽聚焦TF-DNA结合位点发现，但方法为湿实验测序驱动，缺乏AI或物理模拟建模，故属广义蛋白-DNA互作且方法可借鉴的中档文献。
abstract: The variable sigma (σ) subunit of the bacterial RNA polymerase holoenzyme determines promoter specificity and facilitate open complex formation during transcription initiation. Understanding σ-factor binding sequences is therefore crucial for deciphering bacterial gene regulation. Here, we present a data-driven high-throughput approach that utilizes an extensive library of 1.54 million DNA templates providing artificial promoters and 5 ′ UTR sequences for σ-factor DNA binding motif discovery. This method combines the generation of extensive DNA libraries, in vitro transcription, RNA aptamer selection, and deep DNA and RNA sequencing. It allows direct assessment of promoter activity, identification of transcription start sites, and quantification of promoter strength based on mRNA production levels. We applied this approach to map σ 54 DNA binding sequences in Pseudomonas putida . Deep sequencing of the enriched RNA pool revealed 64,966 distinct σ 54 binding motifs, significantly expanding the known repertoire. This data-driven approach surpasses traditional methods by directly evaluating promoter function and avoiding selection bias based solely on binding affinity. This comprehensive dataset enhances our understanding of σ-factor binding sequences and their regulatory roles, opening avenues for new research in biology and biotechnology.
abstract_zh: 细菌RNA聚合酶全酶的可变sigma（σ）亚基决定启动子特异性，并在转录起始过程中促进开放复合物的形成。因此，理解σ因子结合序列对于解析细菌基因调控至关重要。在此，我们提出一种数据驱动的高通量方法，利用包含154万个DNA模板的广泛文库，提供人工启动子和5‘ UTR序列，用于σ因子DNA结合基序的发现。该方法结合了广泛DNA文库的生成、体外转录、RNA适体选择以及深度DNA和RNA测序。它能够直接评估启动子活性、识别转录起始位点，并基于mRNA产生水平定量启动子强度。我们将此方法应用于绘制恶臭假单胞菌（Pseudomonas putida）中的σ54 DNA结合序列。富集RNA池的深度测序揭示了64,966个不同的σ54结合基序，显著扩展了已知的库。这种数据驱动方法通过直接评估启动子功能并避免仅基于结合亲和力的选择偏差，超越了传统方法。这一全面数据集增强了我们对σ因子结合序列及其调控作用的理解，为生物学和生物技术的新研究开辟了途径。
